// Pure characterization of unchanged pinned latency helpers and bundled data.
package latency

import (
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
)

type latencyCaptureTripwire struct{}
func (latencyCaptureTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("latency capture attempted HTTP")
}

type latencyCaptureCase struct {
	Matrix map[string]map[string]float64
	Results []types.RegionComparison
}

func TestRegionLatencyCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_LATENCY_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" { t.Fatal("missing capture output") }
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = latencyCaptureTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: latencyCaptureTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()
	defaultMatrix, defaultAverages := azureRegionLatency, clusterPairAverages
	defer func() { azureRegionLatency, clusterPairAverages = defaultMatrix, defaultAverages }()
	write := func(name string, value any) {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		if err := os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("zz_generated.latency.go")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	hash := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
	blob := fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
	if blob != "64a6abc72e2a54fec286cb27123175d1d6bcda61" { t.Fatal("pinned generated data changed", blob) }
	write("source-latency-data.json", struct {
		SourceBlob string `json:"source_blob"`
		Matrix map[string]map[string]float64 `json:"matrix"`
		Clusters map[string]string `json:"clusters"`
	}{blob, defaultMatrix, regionCluster})
	comparison := func(source, target string) types.RegionComparison {
		return types.RegionComparison{SubscriptionID: "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", SubscriptionName: "selected", SourceRegion: source, TargetRegion: target, SourceResourceTypeCount: 2, AvailableTypes: 1, UnavailableTypes: 1, AvailabilityPercent: 50, TotalSKUsChecked: 1, UnknownSKUs: 1, SKUAvailabilityPercent: 100, MissingResourceTypes: []string{"microsoft.custom/widgets"}, MissingSKUs: []string{"microsoft.custom/widgets:SKU (unknown)"}, RestrictedSKUs: []string{}, ZoneRestrictedSKUs: []string{}, SourceZoneCount: 3, TargetZoneCount: 2, TargetZoneMappings: map[string]string{"1": "phys1"}, AvgLatencyMs: 42, LatencyEstimated: true, HasCostData: true, AvgCostDifference: -5}
	}
	pairs := func(values ...string) []types.RegionComparison {
		result := []types.RegionComparison{}
		for i := 0; i < len(values); i += 2 { result = append(result, comparison(values[i], values[i+1])) }
		return result
	}
	cases := map[string]latencyCaptureCase{
		"synthetic": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{"eastus": {"westeurope": 85, "northeurope": 105, "eastus": 999, "unknownsource": 7}, "westeurope": {"eastus": 115, "northeurope": 30}, "unknown": {"westeurope": 1}}, Results: pairs("eastus", "westeurope", "westeurope", "eastus", "northeurope", "eastus", "westus", "francesouth", "francesouth", "westus", "northeurope", "francesouth", "westus", "westus2", "eastus", "eastus", "unknown", "westeurope", "westeurope", "unknown", "global", "francesouth", "East US", "West Europe")},
		"empty": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{}, Results: pairs("eastus", "eastus", "eastus", "westeurope")},
		"one-way-cluster": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{"eastus": {"westeurope": 80}}, Results: pairs("westus", "francesouth", "francesouth", "westus")},
		"zero": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{"eastus": {"westeurope": 0}}, Results: pairs("eastus", "westeurope", "westus", "francesouth")},
		"negative": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{"eastus": {"westeurope": -2}}, Results: pairs("eastus", "westeurope", "westus", "francesouth")},
		"default": {Matrix: defaultMatrix, Results: pairs("eastus", "westeurope", "austriaeast", "eastus", "eastus", "austriaeast", "qatarcentral", "westeurope", "unknown", "westeurope", "eastus", "eastus", "australiacentral", "australiacentral2")},
		"empty-results": {Matrix: map[string]map[string]float64{}, Results: []types.RegionComparison{}},
	}
	// Record untouched inputs before the source's in-place enrichment runs.
	write("source-latency-inputs.json", cases)
	results := map[string]struct {
		Comparisons []types.RegionComparison `json:"comparisons"`
		Averages map[string]float64 `json:"averages"`
	}{}
	for name, input := range cases {
		azureRegionLatency = input.Matrix
		clusterPairAverages = computeClusterAverages(input.Matrix)
		EnrichWithLatencyData(input.Results)
		results[name] = struct {
			Comparisons []types.RegionComparison `json:"comparisons"`
			Averages map[string]float64 `json:"averages"`
		}{input.Results, clusterPairAverages}
	}
	write("source-latency-outputs.json", results)
	t.Log("Captured 7 latency cases / 27 comparison branches and complete pinned matrix/clusters; no credential/client/network invoked")
}
